plain: In the 1970s, Hal Puthoff, a laser physicist, is said to have started the US government's psychic spy program at the Stanford Research Institute (SRI), a research centre in California. Michels says this himself in several episodes. In one he says Puthoff ran it for the CIA, crediting Joe Rogan, a comedian and podcaster. In another he calls Puthoff the "founding architect of Stargate", the name of the program. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, tells Michels that Puthoff is "a good friend and colleague" who has spoken to him at length about Stargate. Gallaudet runs the program through to 1995 and brings up Paul Smith, Ingo Swann and Joe McMoneagle as part of the story.
